correctness.rationale: The cubics through the four F2 base points form the 6-dimensional subspace of the seven displayed monomials with total coefficient parity 0, thus 63 nonzero rational members. Independent fresh SymPy Groebner computations on all three projective charts classified precisely six geometrically smooth forms with masks 7,22,38,49,51,53, each containing five rational points. Their strict transforms meet the 15 points of S(F2) as the fifteen pair labels of six curves. The representative pair sums to X(XY+Z²); line restriction t² and conic restriction s^4 t(t+s) imply plane local intersection multiplicity six at P2 and multiplicity one at the other base points. Blowing up subtracts one at each and leaves exactly one geometric contact of order five. Independent recomputation of the 24 base-point stabilizer matrices plus quadratic Cremona gives 120 transformations, projective section orbits 6,10,12,15,20 and sharp three-transitivity on the smooth six. This transports the representative contact to all pairs. XOR closure excludes any pencil all of whose three F2 members are smooth.
